title: Agent Skills versus RLHF in AI
desc: A beginner explainer of Jimmy Slagle's tweet that skills are dying and goals with RLHF are the future. Covers what AI agent skills are (written playbooks, not human job skills), why some people say they box models in, what RLHF means in plain English, and how chasing a goal with human-feedback training differs from following a written recipe.

title: How AI Agents Differ From Chatbots
desc: AI agents explained simply: what makes an AI agent different from a chatbot — tools, planning, memory and acting on your behalf.
